title: ПОСЛЕДНЯЯ КОМАНДА: Prologue
description:

Об игре

In "Last Command: Prologue", you can experience the special prologue chapter of the Last Command, an bullet-hell, boss-rush adventure RPG that inspired from the classic Snake game! 

Embark on a Journey in an digital world, the final phase of the mankind's evolution, where the sentients program who used to served human live, laugh, and...

Snake x Bullet Hell = A New Take on the Classic Experience!Grease up your arrow keys and stretch your fingers! Maneuver the Crawler through the enemies’ barrage of attacks and collect Data Points to deal damage! Gain special chips to enhance the Crawler as you progress, overcome intense Boss battles, and uncover the secrets of their program world...

▉ "Last Command" takes inspiration from the classic game "Snake," but adds two additional actions, "Dash" and "Analyze." Make good use of these new actions to dodge attacks and collect "Data" generated in the levels to inflict damage.

▉There are numerous, non-repetitive battles, each with their own unique style and attack pattern ranging from dazzling screen filling barrages to obstacles that wish to overwhelm you. Each one will be a test to your ability to respond to various difficulties.

▉Modules can be found throughout the game and grant a variety of special abilities. Combined together, they can create a "Resonance Effect," granting unique and stronger bonuses. Find the best combination for your playstyle!

▉Overcome dangers and challenges while uncovering long-forgotten secrets left after the disappearance of humans as you explore the vast world of programs.
description_short: Last Command is a fast-paced Snake x Bullet Hell action game. Maneuver through enemies’ barrage of attacks, collect Data Points to deal damage! Mix and match skill chips as you progress, overcome intense Boss battles, and uncover the secrets of their program world...
